evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Operational directive with 'from now on' permanence language and a declarative rule performing the settling — decision-grade conviction.
Flat unhedged assertion of cadence; no ratification language or performed settling, so claim rather than decision.
Flat attribution of ownership; no commitment or ratification language, just a plain assertive statement.
